name: Isla Mayor (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Isla Mayor (a bird and rice on blue and white above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Isla Mayor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Isla Mayor arms — bird and rice on blue and white above waves
